text:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Abort and drain sibling precision requests**

When a quality manifest has multiple precision fixtures and one request rejects while another is still pending, `Promise.all` rejects immediately, after which the catch returns a failure record and `finally` clears the run's timeout without aborting the controller. The sibling request can therefore continue indefinitely beyond `passTimeoutMs`, overlap the next `--runs` iteration, and escape the recorded per-run cost/deadline boundary. Abort the controller on the first rejection and await settlement of all sibling requests before completing the run.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L45-L45](https://github.com/lhpaul/ronda/blob/017546a803dd073733d47d0f3fe73f3ffd072b5d/AGENTS.md#L45-L45)
